snippet.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - Out Now Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

In 1499 Paris, Rose Belmont, daughter of Trevor Belmont, takes on a demonic invasion in this 2D action-exploration game from Konami, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.
